name: foreman-ui
description: Foreman inside Claude Code: one docked panel that fits the screen, a band above the prompt when it's closed, toasts and one-press approve/next/drive/inbox actions.

freshAt.title: Compact at task boundaries (context %)
freshAt.description: When a task closes with context at or above this percent, compact so the next task starts fresh. 0 turns it off.

freshTokens.title: Compact at task boundaries (context tokens)
freshTokens.description: When a task closes with at least this many context tokens, compact so the next task starts fresh: every turn re-reads the whole context. 0 turns it off.

mascot.title: Mascot
mascot.description: The animated Claude in the Foreman pane's top-right corner.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: full: the pane's charts move at about 30 fps while work runs. reduced: everything moves at the 8 fps frame clock. off: no animation; the pane redraws only when something changes. The same words as fm code's motion setting; calm is the old word for reduced.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: default: green and red for ok and error. cb: a colourblind-safe blue and orange pair (errors also carry a glyph). riso: risograph inks, green, fluorescent pink and cornflower; the same words as fm code's palette setting.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: tree: each turn reads as one tree (your prompt the root, every call a branch, finished calls compact: a passing command's output folded, diffs four lines, failures in full). full: the long rows, every command and its output.
